exposure: Obstetricians' cognitive and affective traits (Reflective Coping, Proactive Coping, Multiple Stimulus Types Ambiguity Tolerance (MSTAT), Need for Cognition, State-Trait Anxiety Inventory)
Quartile scores on each psychometric scale
outcome: Trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) frequency
cohort: 1502 primiparous women with 1 prior low transverse cesarean delivery and a term, cephalic singleton
finding: Obstetricians with higher levels of proactive coping and lower levels of anxiety were more likely to have patients who underwent TOLAC and achieved VBAC.
